mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, s.full_name AS student_name, u.full_name AS created_by_name FROM iep_programs p JOIN students s ON s.id = p.student_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iep_programs (student_id, title, academic_year, start_date, end_date, present_levels, accommodations, status, created_by) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{title}, #{academicYear}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{presentLevels}, #{accommodations}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: WHERE p.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY p.academic_year DESC, p.created_at DESC
WHERE p.student_id = #{studentId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.start_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iep_programs WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND academic_year = #{academicYear} AND id <> #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iep_goals (iep_id, domain, description, target_date, status, progress_pct) VALUES (#{iepId}, #{domain}, #{description}, #{targetDate}, #{status}, #{progressPct})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM iep_goals WHERE iep_id = #{iepId} ORDER BY domain, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iep_goal_progress_history (goal_id, recorded_on, progress_pct, recorded_by) VALUES (#{goalId}, CURDATE(), #{progressPct}, #{recordedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress_pct = VALUES(progress_pct), recorded_by = VALUES(recorded_by)
